rationale: One placement rule for every Lisp argument avoids splitting arguments between Wasm parameters and an overflow area. Choose B for simplicity and clarity on the reviewed correctness basis.
user_direction: For the record, when this is written down it should be recorded as a project decision with a dated rationale, not as the output of the frozen benchmark rule, since the policy's minima were never met. That keeps the evidence honest and lets Stage 1 proceed on B without a measurement claim behind it.
direction_provenance: User to Codex in this project conversation; the existing 12 September ABI choice and policy-change record establish the decision date. This record formalizes that choice without granting acceptance to itself.

abi.argument_owner: caller; callee restores incoming VSP before the caller releases it
abi.extra_values: caller-owned rooted VSP region referenced by the TCR multiple-value descriptor; lifetime ends on owner reuse or release
abi.nested_values: copy earlier retained results to owned rooted storage before reusing the output region
abi.result_scanners: exactly one scanner per physical result slot; ownership handoffs occur without polling

module_granularity.correctness_fixture: one callable definition per module plus support/runtime; cross-instance indirect dispatch
module_granularity.initial_generated_bootstrap: proposed small number of coherent, eagerly installed bundles

continuing_obligations: publish live roots at stopping boundaries; reload moved values and rederive addresses
preserve logical debugger frames, source identity and declared availability policy
preserve VSP/TSP/CSP, result ownership, bindings, handlers and cleanup across tails, callbacks and exceptions
validate code versions, entry roles, signatures and installation before publication
confirm the selected B protocol through real compiler-generated code
complete the independent engine matrix, census and contracts join
measure startup, scale and memory with useful generated code
publication_limit: S0-LL21-a publishes a generation and code/version digest; every Worker already holds the bytes. It proves neither byte delivery nor Wasm-side acquire.
reopen_for: demonstrated generated-code correctness problem attributable to B
representative performance problem attributable to B
